intro: Conscript of the Horde is an introductory transition quest that directs young Horde adventurers out of Durotar and into the vast wilderness of the Barrens. Initiated by the scout Takrin Pathseeker along the western road from Razor Hill, it sends recruits across the Southfury River to Kargal Battlescar's border outpost.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Listen, my good friend Kargal needs some new recruits for Barrens duty. I know you want to do what's right for the Horde. Well, this is your chance.
Take this recruitment letter to Kargal and see if he'll sign it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What do you want, pup? If you're not here for recruitment, I don't have time for you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, so Takrin sent you? He's an excellent scout, I'm not sure what I'd do without him.
I'll sign your recruitment letter, but what we really need is someone at the Crossroads.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
